user.title: Connect to the WhatsApp Gateway
user.description: Enter the address and API key of the WhatsApp Gateway add-on. The hostname is shown on the add-on's Info page.

data_description.api_key: The api_key set in the add-on configuration.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with the WhatsApp Gateway
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {url} rejected the API key. Enter the current key from the add-on configuration.

data_description.api_key: The api_key set in the add-on configuration.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway. Check the URL and that the add-on is running.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the API key.

init.title: WhatsApp recipients
init.description: Each recipient becomes a notify entity.

data_description.name: Used for the entity name, for example Alice.

add_group.title: Add group
add_group.description: The linked WhatsApp number must be a member of the group.

data_description.group: Pick one of the groups the linked number belongs to.
data_description.name: Used for the entity name. Defaults to the group name.

error.invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number with 7 to 15 digits.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the API key.

abort.no_groups: No groups were found. Add the linked WhatsApp number to a group first, then try again.

not_connected.message: WhatsApp is not connected on the gateway. Check the add-on's status page.

all_targets_failed.message: The message could not be sent to any target: {errors}

path_not_allowed.message: Reading {path} is not allowed. Add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.

file_too_large.message: {path} is larger than the 16 MiB limit.

message_required.message: A message is required unless an image or document is given.

multiple_media.message: Only one of image_url, image_path or document_path can be given.

entity_not_found.message: {entity_id} is not a WhatsApp recipient entity.

config_entry_not_found.message: No WhatsApp gateway config entry was found.

multiple_config_entries.message: More than one WhatsApp gateway is configured. Specify config_entry_id.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the WhatsApp gateway.

invalid_auth.message: The WhatsApp gateway rejected the API key.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a WhatsApp message, optionally with an image or document, to one or more recipients.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: The gateway to send with. Optional when only one is configured.

target.name: Target
target.description: Recipients: notify entities from this integration, phone numbers, JIDs or group:Name (for example group:Family).

message.name: Message
message.description: The message text. Required unless an image or document is given.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional title, shown in bold above the message.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: An http or https URL of an image to send.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Path of a local image file. It must be in an allowed folder.

document_path.name: Document path
document_path.description: Path of a local file to send as a document. It must be in an allowed folder.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Caption for the image or document. Defaults to the message.

list_groups.name: List groups
list_groups.description: Returns the groups the linked WhatsApp account is a member of, with their JIDs.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: The gateway to query. Optional when only one is configured.
